setup_encoder_text: In your encoder choose a custom RTMP server, paste one of these URLs and keep the stream key from your platform. OpenDelay forwards the key unchanged. With a custom server the encoder no longer applies the platform's recommended settings: set the keyframe interval to 2 s and the rate control to CBR (OBS: Settings → Output), otherwise viewers may only see a black screen.

setup_dock_text: In OBS choose Docks → Custom Browser Docks, enter a name such as OpenDelay and this URL.
setup_app: Routes, hotkeys and the other settings are in the OpenDelay window.
